Vishun Pad Yadav|72 | Male | Yadav | Veteran Social Worker

a) Current Profile: Vishun Pad Yadav is a veteran social worker/leader and benevolent personality of Banke Bazar who has been continuously working, supporting, and advocating various humanitarian causes and issues in his area.

b) Socio-political Brief: His political-social journey started in 1978 when he contested for the Mukhiya's election. Thereafter, he did not contest for any seats.

The first service which he gave to a social cause was land Donation. He donated his 5 Acres of land to build a School especially to allow children from lower castes who have been discriminated against and not allowed to sit and study together with other children. He founded Janta Ucch Vidaylaya in 1987 to enable children from downtrodden society. 

He founded "Navyuvak Sangh in 1991" which worked to end discrimination and to support communities who failed to cremate their families' bodies and failed to pay the last homage. 
With the participation of communities, he laid various such initiatives to support and enable the downtrodden members of society.

c) Educational Background: He has completed his education till 10th grade. Matric pass.
d) Financial Activities: He is in good financial condition

e) Area|Community Influence: He has an enormous influence over the community members particularly among community leaders.

f) Public Perception: He is widely respected and admired for his selfless dedication to social welfare. He is perceived as a benevolent figure who has actively worked to uplift the downtrodden and advocate for equality and justice in his community.

g) Recent Activities: He has donated his body for medical research and organ transplantation, perhaps to establish his legacy.

Amod Kr Chandravanshi  41| Male| Incumbent Mukhiya 
a) Current Profile:Currently he is Mukhiya of Chandragarh and Pradesh Mahasachiv of EBC Prakoshth from last 8 years.
b) Socio-political Brief: His grandfather was closely associated with S.N. Singh,then CM. His name was Kalicharan Singh and he lost the first panchayat election. He was a freedom fighter and went to jail multiple times.
Amod Chandrawanshi was ABVP Student Union leader from 1991 to 2004, and student union leader from 2001 to 2006. He was Adhyaksh of friends club Nabinagar from 2004 to 2012. He was also Adhyaksh of Matrubhoomi Navnirman Yuva Sangh from 2004 to 2012.His mother lost the mukhiya election by 183 votes in 2011 to Sumitra Devi. His aunt Kusum Devi contested the Municipal Election in 2012 of Nabinagar and won by approx 2000 votes. He won the Mukhiya election from Chandragarh by around 200 votes, defeating Taskin Jahan. His Mother won ward councillor election from Ward No 12 by 130 votes. He won 2021 Mukhiya vote by 30 votes,defeating Sanjiv Kumar who was also Purva Pramukh. One thing to note is that he has been winning all these elections from a general seat himself being an EBC.Both his mother and his aunt are currently Ward councillors. He has also been Adhyaksh of Mukhiya Sangh from 2021 to 2023.He is Pradesh Mahasachiv of Bihar Kshetriya Chandravanshi Mahasabha.He went to jail for 52 days for Jansamasya.He did protest and talabandi of SDO office due to electricity problem.
c) Educational Background: BA (hons) Political Science.
d) Financial Activities: He has 2 Bigha land in town and  30 bigha in rural areas.He also has a ITI College (Chandrashekhar Singh Chandravanshi College). His declared property is about 2.5 crores. He also has a sweet shop. He has a JCB. His elder brother has a motor parts shop.
 e) Area|Community Influence: He has good reach in his whole block and assembly area. His reach is among all the communities.
f) Public Perception: Clean and Socially Active.
g) Recent Activities: He planted 25000 trees in the Jal Jeevan Hariyali scheme. He donates 20-25000 in marriages of poor people. He renovated ponds from his own money.

a) Current Profile: He is the Incumbent Mukhiya of Dihara Panchayat and a former ZP contestant.

g) Recent Activities: He has recently distributed benefits under various government schemes, including 2500 Vridha Awas Yojana, 1700 Viklang certificates, and 500 Ayushman scheme benefits, contributing to the welfare of the community. In 2016 the seat was reserved for Women-General so he nominated his wife Sunita Devi's name for the position pf Mukhiya and lost the elections by a margin of 316 votes, scoring 900 votes becoming the second runner-up. Shivshankar the eldest of Ramshankar and Umashankar has been the head of his family, which has been quite dominant in his panchayat since a while and held electoral positions and now he is slowly retiring and his son Ajit Yadav is quite active in panchayat politics and the de facto leader of current PACS Adhyaksh, BDC, Up-Mukhiya & 8 Ward Sadasya of his panchayat.

a)Current Profile: Anand is the incumbent BDC from Kari panchayat.

b) Socio-political Brief: He has been active in politics since 2006 but contested elections for the first time in 2021 for the position of Panchayat Samiti and won the elections by a margin of 110 votes, scoring 919 votes against 5 other candidates. Before contesting elections he was the Prakhand Adhyaksh (2019-2022) of Bhartiya Sablok Party formed by ex-MP Arun Kumar, for a period of 3 years before the party merged with LJP. After the 2024 No Confidence Motion was instilled upon Tinku Yadav, he nominated his name for Up-Pramukh against Janardan Paswan but lost by 3 votes, getting 10 votes.

Through his NGO, he ran awareness campaigns for Swacchta and open defecation, and to tackle this, he helped people in getting access to government ODF schemes for construction & remuneration of toilets. 

Apart from social service and contesting elections himself, he has also managed Chitranjan Kumar aka Chintu's 2024 Lok Sabha elections campaign & nomination of PRI members on his own goodwill such as Navlesh Paswan - BDC of Karjara, Harun Raseed Khan - ZP Contestant, etc.

"Dr. Shyamnandan Sharma | 68 | Male| Bhumihar| General 

- 1967 MBSS Student : Jamshedpur Medical College 
- Convenor : Jamshedpur Medical College Chhatrsangh (1968) 
- Bihar State Vice President : AlSF (CPI Student Wing) 1968
- Establish a hospital in Paliganj (1973) 
- BPSC qualified, but not joined (1974) 
- Resined from CPI in 1974 - 75 (due to support of Emergency) 
- During the Emergency, he was in Bhagalpur Jail (01 Oct 1975) 
- 1978 - Againg Joined CPI, & MLA Candidate from Paliganj in 1980
- CPI (M) State Committee Member, Kisan Sabha Central Committee Member (1981) 
- Jila Adhyaksh, Patna Gramin, Kisan Sabha - CPI-M Kisan Front (1982) 
- CPI-M MLA Candidate (1990) , but Party refused to fight the election due to Janta Party pressure, then Dr. Sharma supports CPI-ML Candidate
- IPF Member in 1990 (CPI-ML Old name) 
- He was the main campaign Incharge of CPI-ML Candidate (Nand Kumar Nanda), and won this seat (2005) 
- 2014 - left CPI-ML due to some Party policies
- HAM Party National Spokesperson & Central Committee Member (2015-16) 
- left HAM Party due to the support of the BJP (2018) 
- Again joined CPI-ML (2019) 
- Star Pracharak of CPI-ML Candidate Sandip Saurabh, & won this seat (2020) 
- In 2022, again left CPI-ML, due to MLA Sandip Saurabh Corrupted politics. 
- Feb 2023, met with Prashant Kishor, joined Jan Suraj Abhiyan
- He has Major control in Bhumihar, Muslim, Kushwaha & Dalit Communities"

Rameshwar Baitha | 37 | Male | Dhobi | Zila Parishad Deputy Chairman

a) Current Profile: He is Deputy Chairman of Zila Parishad and Zila Parishad sadasya from Sanda of Kutumba. 
b) Socio-political Brief: He was born in 1984, his father was a washerman and due to low income he and his brother was not able to study, therefore he is a non metric. At a very early age he started earning for his family by driving auto from Sanda to Aurangabad. He was very helpful so with the help of society he contested Panchayat elections for the first time from the lowest level and secured the seat of ward member by the margin of 3 votes (2001-06). In the next term he contested for Mukhiya (2006-11) but lost by the margin of 260 votes (SC seat).  In the next term he came back with full preparations and contested for Mukhiya again (2011-16) and finally won by the margin of 300 votes by defeating the brother of Lallan Bhuiya (Ex-MLA). Then back in 2016 he contested for ZP Member elections from Sanda seat but lost here by the gap of 142 votes (2016-21). He was getting prepared for the next term and came back, fought and created the gap of 2025 votes in between him and second position (2021-26). Soonafter, one month he was elected from within the members as the Zila parishad upadhyaksh aheading by 6 votes (2021-26). Also, he is associated with BJP from last 8 years and he holds the position of "Zila SC Morcha Adhyaksh" (2021-24), prior which he has also been "Mandal Koshadhyaksha" (2018-21).
c) Educational Background: He is a non metric.
d) Financial Activities: He is running a Tent house from 1999 named as, 'Sonu Tent House'. Also, he owns a ice factory.
e) Area|Community Influence: He has good influence oer the community as he provides free of cost Tent service to those who are needy. Being available to the people throughout the time created a good perception of him in the area.
f) Public Perception: Positive
g) Recent Activities: He supported BJP candidate in the recent Lok Sabha elections (2024).
